titles.title: paras: put any software into your language, and prove it still works

descriptions.description: paras points at any Git repository and puts it into any of Hindawi's languages: keywords, numerals and names through a dictionary. It checks the result converts back to the original byte for byte, lowers it through the original Hindawi pipeline, builds and runs it, and compares its output with the English build; what is not yet translated is reported with an issue to file. It carries a layered stack from the SHAKTI SDK, firmware and operating systems to toolchains and AI frameworks, publishes each language as a branch of a fork, and runs in a container. Verified so far: SHAKTI bare metal and xv6 from Urdu, Tamil and Hindi on QEMU; xv6 and darknet from Urdu converting back byte for byte and printing what English prints. The rest is defined and marked as not yet run.
